title: Astronauts Just Flew 100 Million Miles Without Going Anywhere

scenes.text: Four astronauts just flew 100 million miles without leaving orbit.
Crew-12 spent two hundred thirty-seven days on the space station.
They circled Earth over three thousand seven hundred times.
Each orbit takes about ninety minutes.
They splashed down in the Pacific, off Los Angeles, on October 8.
Sixteen sunrises every single day, for eight months.
A hundred million miles, and they came home to the same planet.

description:
Four astronauts just flew 100 million miles without leaving orbit.
NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 spent 237 days on the International Space Station, completing more than 3,792 orbits before splashing down on October 8, 2026.
Would you spend eight months up there?
first_comment: Bonus: the crew included NASA's Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway and ESA's Sophie Adenot. Where would you go next?
